title: Technique catalogue performance update — September 30, 2026
method: Same fixture, catalogue, machine, browser/version/viewport and observer. Serial local emulator actions. Matched original-code control served from git e0a4e3f on port 5029; updated code on 5027. No production requests or writes.

browser.phaseNote: Initial tab showed a roughly fourfold slowdown after a read-only browser evaluation; unchanged Attributes also slowed. Cause is not established. This phase is retained separately. Original-code control and clean updated tab used snapshots/locators without page evaluation. No observed crash. Longer control/save actions exceeded browser-tool deadlines but completed; each dispatched action was awaited and never retried blindly.
